opportunities.title: Game-Ready UE5 Mobile Workover Rig
opportunities.description: 3D Artist Needed – Detailed Game-Ready Mobile Workover Rig for Unreal Engine 5 Project Overview I’m an independent game developer working on a realistic oilfield simulation game in Unreal Engine 5. I’m seeking an experienced 3D modeller to design and create a complete, high-quality, game-ready truck-mounted mobile workover/service rig based on real-world oilfield equipment. This is a significant gameplay asset that players will operate directly, so both visual quality and mechanical accuracy are important. Asset Requirements The model should include the major components of a conventional mobile workover rig, such as: * Detailed heavy-duty truck chassis, wheels, and cab. * Telescopic mast with appropriate structural bracing and lifting mechanisms. * Crown block and travelling block assemblies. * Drawworks, drums, and realistic wire rope routing. * Rig floor, access walkways, ladders, and working platforms. * Hydraulic cylinders, stabilisers/outriggers, and supporting equipment. * Control stations, fuel tanks, mechanical housings, and relevant rig accessories. The exact equipment configuration will be agreed upon using reference material before modelling begins. The initial rig is intended to be a conventional mobile service rig without a monkey board. Visual Style The game uses a stylized low-poly aesthetic for vehicles and machinery, while maintaining realistic proportions, recognisable mechanical detail, and convincing PBR materials. The model should look polished and professional, not overly simplified, blocky, or cartoonish. Technical Requirements * Optimised for real-time use in Unreal Engine 5. * Clean topology and efficient polygon distribution. * Proper UV mapping and PBR textures. * Separately modelled mechanical components where movement or animation is required. * Correctly configured pivot points for moving assemblies. * Suitable LODs for performance optimisation. * Organised hierarchy and sensible naming conventions. * Deliverables including Blender source files (or agreed equivalent), FBX exports, and all required textures. * Commercial usage rights for the final asset. The asset should be prepared for future gameplay implementation, including raising the mast, operating the drawworks, moving the travelling block, and other workover operations. Who I’m Looking For Ideally, applicants should have experience with: * 3D vehicle or heavy machinery modelling. * Mechanical/industrial equipment. * Game-ready asset production and optimisation. * Blender, Maya, or similar software. * Unreal Engine asset workflows. Previous oilfield equipment experience would be an advantage, but isn’t essential if you can demonstrate strong mechanical modelling skills and the ability to work accurately from references. Project Expectations I will provide reference images and collaborate with the selected artist to establish the appropriate rig configuration before production. The project will be completed through agreed milestones, with opportunities for review and feedback throughout development. When Applying, Please Include: 1. Examples of relevant modelling work. 2. Your estimated project cost. 3. Your anticipated completion timeframe. 4. Your preferred modelling software. 5. A brief explanation of your approach to modelling complex mechanical equipment. There is potential for ongoing work involving additional oilfield rigs, vehicles, and machinery as development progresses. I’m prioritising quality, accuracy, communication, and reliable delivery over the cheapest available quote.

You’ll work remotely on your own equipment, but must have a stable connection for VoIP calls and video check-ins. Deliverables are considered complete when each new claim is fully documented, all communications are logged in English, and the client receives confirmation—in Spanish—that everything is underway. If you’re detail-oriented, comfortable juggling multiple claims, and ready to start immediately, I look forward to streamlining this process together.

opportunities.title: Service-Booking Website for El Paraíso
opportunities.description: I need a clean, modern website for mi negocio “El paraíso de Ana” that lets customers discover my services and confirm their reservations entirely online. The site’s core purpose is clear: sell services through an integrated booking experience, not physical products or downloads. Design & content The look should reflect a welcoming, paradisiacal vibe, work flawlessly on mobile, tablet, and desktop, and load quickly from the first click. I will supply logos, photos, and copy; you translate that into a cohesive layout with intuitive navigation. Booking flow • Catalog of services with descriptions, duration, and price • Real-time availability calendar and time-slot selection • Secure checkout with the most common card options (and PayPal or Stripe if it simplifies set-up) • Automatic email or WhatsApp confirmations plus reminders for both the client and me • Dashboard where I can add, edit, or block slots in seconds Admin essentials • Simple CMS to update text, images, and pricing without coding • Order / reservation history with status filters and export option • Basic SEO settings (titles, meta descriptions, friendly URLs) Acceptance criteria 1. A visitor can go from homepage to paid reservation in under three clicks. 2. Test bookings trigger confirmation messages and appear in the admin panel. 3. Site scores 90+ on Google Lighthouse mobile performance. 4. All content is delivered in Spanish; backend labels may stay in English if unavoidable. Please include the estimated timeline for design, development, one revision round, and final hand-over along with the tech stack you propose (WordPress with WooCommerce Bookings, Shopify with an appointment app, or a comparable solution you are comfortable maintaining).

opportunities.title: n8n AI Support Automation
opportunities.description: I’m building an email-only support desk that runs entirely on n8n and taps two large-language-model endpoints—Claude and Gemini—so that every incoming message in our inbox is answered automatically. The agent’s single purpose is to handle customer questions and support requests with the best possible answer it can assemble from those two models. When the combined confidence drops below an agreed threshold, the workflow must route the original email (with the draft answer and model reasoning attached) straight to a human teammate for manual follow-up. Here’s what I need from you: • A fully commented n8n workflow (exportable JSON) that watches the inbox via IMAP/Gmail, invokes Claude and Gemini sequentially or in parallel, chooses or blends their responses, then sends the reply through SMTP/Gmail. • Clear logic for confidence scoring and the automatic escalation path to a human address or shared mailbox when the answer isn’t reliable. • Prompt templates, environment variable names, and any helper functions written in Code nodes so I can fine-tune behaviour later. • Short setup notes covering keys, quotas, and the exact model versions used, plus a test plan so I can verify that (a) confident questions receive an immediate answer and (b) uncertain questions are forwarded correctly. If you’re comfortable chaining multi-model calls in n8n and know how to keep email threads intact, I’d love to see how you’d tackle this.

opportunities.title: n8n + Claude/Gemini Automation
opportunities.description: I need an end-to-end n8n workflow that orchestrates both Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini so my website chat widget can intelligently handle company documents. The goal is simple: a visitor drops a question into chat, the agent finds the relevant passages in my existing files, and replies with a clear, cited answer—no hallucinations, no lost context. Scope • Build the n8n workflow: file ingestion, vector-based search, Claude + Gemini prompt routing, and response formatting. • Connect the flow to a browser-friendly chat front-end (iframe or JS snippet is fine). • Support secure upload or scheduled sync of new PDFs, Word docs, and Google Docs so the knowledge base stays fresh. • Expose simple knobs in n8n so I can switch models or adjust temperature without touching code. Acceptance Criteria 1. Chat answers must be traceable to at least one source excerpt from the stored documents. 2. Average response time under five seconds with ≤20 MB test corpus. 3. Workflow, environment variables, and any helper scripts delivered in an importable n8n JSON plus a README that lets me reproduce the setup from scratch. Tools you’ll probably rely on: n8n (self-host), Claude API, Gemini API, a vector store such as Pinecone or Weaviate, and a lightweight chat UI (React, Vue, or plain JS). Hand-off all API keys in .env placeholders and keep the codebase MIT or similarly permissive—no hidden dependencies. I’m ready to test as soon as you share the workflow export and setup guide.

opportunities.title: Violin Posture 3D Anatomy Images
opportunities.description: I’d like a skilled Blender artist to create a concise collection of high-resolution anatomical stills that illustrate healthy violin technique. We will begin with skeleton poses for violin playing, and each frame needs to display the full playing posture from head to feet. I will supply detailed photographs, angle notes, and colour-coded highlighting instructions for every shot. Deliverables • High-res PNGs on transparent backgrounds, ready for print and web • The corresponding .blend files • Up to two revision rounds per image Licensing & assets Only use skeleton or muscle models cleared for commercial print use—no CC BY-SA, non-commercial, or AI-generated sources. Before modelling starts, tell me the exact source and licence of every asset so I can approve them. All finished renders and project files become my property once the job is paid in full. How to respond Please send 2–3 relevant anatomy or skeleton examples, your price per image, expected turnaround, and the skeleton model you recommend using. Blender expertise, clean topology, and an eye for accurate biomechanics will be highly valued.

opportunities.title: Roblox Trading Automation Backend Integration
opportunities.description: # Hiring Experienced Roblox Automation Developer – Adopt Me Trading Bot System I'm looking for an experienced developer to build a Roblox Adopt Me trading bot system and integrate it with my existing website. (Please note that i am already aware of the risks and im completely fine with it and take full responsibility) The website is already built using Node.js and SQLite. I'm not looking for someone to create a new website. I specifically need someone who can develop the bot infrastructure and connect it to my existing backend. ### Project Requirements 1. Automated Trading System I need a system that can manage multiple Roblox accounts assigned to different roles: - Deposit bots: Handle incoming pet deposits and report verified transactions to my backend. - Withdrawal bots: Handle pet withdrawals based on requests submitted through my website. - Middleman bots: Coordinate trades between users where required. The system should manage trade requests, track transaction statuses and prevent duplicate transactions. 2. Pet Recognition and Trade Verification I need a reliable way to identify pets offered in Adopt Me trades, including: - Pet names and quantities. - Neon and Mega Neon variations. - Fly and Ride variations. - Combinations such as NFR and MFR. - Changes to the items offered during a trade. I'm open to using Python, OpenCV, machine learning or another suitable technology. The developer should explain how recognition accuracy will be tested and how successful trades can be independently verified. 3. Roblox Client Automation I'm looking for a developer who can propose a technically feasible approach for interacting with Roblox and handling trades. The developer should explain what tools would be required, whether the solution can run on cloud-hosted infrastructure. 4. Backend Integration My existing backend uses Node.js and SQLite. The bot system should communicate with it using REST APIs and WebSockets. It should support real-time trade updates, bot status monitoring, inventory management and transaction logging. 5. Multiple Bot Management Initially, I'm considering running approximately 5–10 bots simultaneously, with the ability to scale further. I need an admin dashboard that allows me to: - Register and remove bots. - Assign deposit, withdrawal or middleman roles. - Monitor bot availability. - View recorded inventories. - Replace unavailable bot accounts. - Review failed or incomplete transactions. 6. Hosting and Reliability The system should be designed to operate on cloud-hosted infrastructure without requiring my personal computer to remain switched on. It should include connection monitoring, automatic recovery from network failures, appropriate rate limiting and safeguards against duplicate trade processing. The developer should also explain how the system handles disconnected users, interrupted trades and unavailable inventory. ### Preferred Technologies - Node.js - SQLite - Socket.IO / WebSockets - Python - OpenCV - Roblox Luau, where supported - Cloud hosting I'm open to other technologies if they're more appropriate. ### What I'm Looking For Ideally, you should have experience with Roblox development, automation systems, computer vision, backend integration and real-time applications. Before development begins, I'd like to discuss the proposed architecture, technical feasibility and estimated development time Please include the following in your application: 1. Your previous experience with Roblox or similar automation projects. 2. Your proposed approach to trade recognition and interaction. 3. Whether you've built comparable systems before. 4. Your estimated development timeline. I'm looking for someone who can build a reliable, maintainable system that integrates with my existing website rather than starting the entire project from scratch.

opportunities.title: Custom Knight Online Bot Needed
opportunities.description: I run a private Knight Online server and I’m looking for a developer who can build a KOXP-style automation tool tailored to my environment. The bot has to grind mobs on its own, fire off the right skills in rotation, scoop up every drop, sort the inventory, sell the junk to the closest NPC, then teleport or walk to the next spot and even finish the repeatable quests along the way—completely hands-free. Stability and stealth are critical; the bot needs to hook cleanly into the KO client, read game memory without triggering common anti-cheat tools, and keep latency to a minimum so that movement and skill timings look human. A small overlay or other clear interface where I can toggle features, set skill priorities, edit farming routes, and configure quest loops will make testing and daily use easier. You should already know your way around Knight Online packets, offsets, and encryption, whether you prefer C++, C#, or another language that lets you inject or external-read safely. I’m open to your architectural choices as long as the final build is uncomplicated to launch on Windows and future offsets can be updated quickly. Deliverables that will let me sign off: • A compiled bot that runs on the current client of my private server, with automatic hunting, farming/looting/selling, and teleport + quest completion all verified in-game. • A clean configuration method (GUI overlay, INI, or similar) so I can tweak skills, items, and paths without touching code. • Documentation and commented source or update instructions so future patches don’t break the tool. If you’ve written KO bots before, show me a short clip or executable demo and we’ll move ahead right away.

opportunities.title: Teman Curhat Via Chat Harian
opportunities.description: Saya mencari seseorang yang bisa menjadi teman ngobrol santai setiap hari melalui chat teks. Fokus utamanya adalah mendengarkan dengan empati sambil membuat obrolan terasa ringan dan nyaman. Ruang lingkup: • Hadir setiap hari (senin-minggu), minimal sekali sesi chat ±30 menit—fleksibel di sore atau malam hari. • Topik obrolan mencakup kegiatan sehari-hari, hobi, serta perasaan, stres, dan masalah pribadi yang mungkin saya alami. • Memberi dukungan emosional dasar dan perspektif positif; bukan terapi profesional, cukup seperti sahabat daring yang siap menanggapi dengan hangat. • Balasan cepat saat sesi (≤ 5–10 menit) supaya alur ngobrol tetap hidup. • Komunikasi sepenuhnya lewat platform chat teks pilihan kita bersama (WhatsApp, Telegram, atau Discord). Saya menghargai pendengar yang sabar, ramah, dan bisa menjaga kerahasiaan cerita. Jika sesekali perlu format lain seperti panggilan suara, kita bisa diskusikan nanti, namun fokus utama tetap chat teks. Beritahu saya: 1. Pengalaman Anda menjadi pendengar atau peer supporter. 2. Zona waktu dan ketersediaan harian. 3. Gaya komunikasi yang biasa Anda pakai agar saya tahu kecocokannya. Saya menantikan partner curhat yang bisa membuat hari-hari terasa lebih ringan.

opportunities.title: WordPress Event Registration Integration
opportunities.description: I’m setting up an event on my WordPress site and need the full registration flow put in place. Scope of work – Build or configure the WordPress form and map it to Stripe Checkout. WordPress, Brevo & Stripe – flow process for events that is repeatable in the future and can be moved to a new website in the near future 1. Project Objective Build one complete, working event registration, payment, with email communication system using the existing WordPress website, Brevo account, and Stripe account integration. The system must support a repeatable setup to be used for independent events while only changing the event details each time. The client will provide all email content and event-specific information. The freelancer is responsible for building the flow with technical configuration, integration, automation logic, basic testing, and written documentation to sign off. The automation is to come from the existing aspects of Registration form, Brevo and Stripe Basic Concept of flow Brevo Flow = Registration form on wordpress event page>submit will add to an event list and main list>sends email of registration to client and admin >takes client to stripe payment link> On payment > adds client to secondary list of paid and if they do not pay to an Unpaid relevant to the event name and list 2 Days prior to the event email goes to unpaid list as a reminder for payment > if they pay the persons registration gets added to the paid list 8 hours prior to the event > email with event details gets sent to paid list Anyone registering and pays after this window gets added to the main list and the paid list and gets the event details via email People can register and pay up to the end of the event Email to be sent post event manual timing for the recordings. – Connect the successful payment webhook to Brevo so the confirmation email fires instantly. – Style the email template inside Brevo to match my existing brand colors and add a calendar-add link – Test the entire flow end-to-end in both Stripe test mode and live mode, fixing any field mapping or formatting issues you notice. – Hand over clear instructions (or a short Loom) showing me how to update prices, dates, or email copy in the future. Acceptance criteria 1. A new user can register, pay, and receive the confirmation email without manual intervention. 2. All captured data appears in both WordPress form entries and the Brevo contact record. 3. No duplicate or missing records after multiple test submissions. 4. Visual styling matches the current site on desktop and mobile. Webpage is ready, the email content will be provided. Please quote based on your expectation of payment from this listing. If something needs to be added can be discussed. Thanks for your attention to this !

Project Objective Build one complete, working event registration, payment, with email communication system using the existing WordPress website, Brevo account, and Stripe account integration. The system must support a repeatable setup to be used for independent events while only changing the event details each time. The client will provide all email content and event-specific information. opportunities.title: n8n AI Multi-Channel Support
opportunities.description: I need a set of n8n workflows that tap into both Claude and Gemini so our customers receive instant, high-quality answers over email as well as WhatsApp or social media DMs. The flow should detect the incoming channel, choose the most relevant model, and return a concise, helpful reply. When confidence is low, the agent must seamlessly request additional details from the customer rather than escalating to a human. Key deliverables • Production-ready n8n workflow file(s) with clear naming and comments • Secure API integrations for Claude and Gemini, including any prompt-engineering needed for reliable answers • Channel connectors configured for IMAP/SMTP (email) and the chosen WhatsApp/social messaging API, with graceful error handling • Fallback logic that auto-asks follow-up questions when confidence drops below an agreed threshold Acceptance criteria 1. I can import the workflow into a fresh n8n instance, add my credentials, and run it without edits. 2. Test messages on each channel receive model answers that reference the original question accurately at least 90 % of the time. 3. Low-confidence scenarios trigger the follow-up request rather than a blank or incorrect answer. If you’ve built multi-model agents or complex n8n automations before, let’s get this running.

opportunities.title: Diseño Taza Sublimación PASTOR
opportunities.description: Necesito un arte listo para sublimar en una taza de 11 oz que combine elegancia y mensaje cristiano. El concepto gira en torno al acróstico “PASTOR”, dispuesto verticalmente con letras protagonistas y los siguientes textos completos: P: Predicador fiel de la Palabra A: Acompañante en todo tiempo S: Servidor con un corazón humilde T: Testigo del amor de Cristo O: Orientador con sabiduría R: Reflejo del buen Pastor, nuestro Señor Jesucristo Quiero un estilo claramente elegante y religioso: tonos sobrios (por ejemplo, beige, marfil, dorado tenue o azul profundo), tipografía serif refinada y una cruz discreta que refuerce el carácter sagrado sin recargar. A un costado debe ir una Biblia abierta bañada por una luz suave; al otro costado, el acróstico. La distribución debe sentirse equilibrada cuando la taza se gire entre ambas zonas de impresión. Entrego la pieza a imprenta, así que necesito: • Archivo final vectorial (AI, PDF o SVG) y PNG 300 DPI a tamaño real (aprox. 21 × 9 cm). • Colores en CMYK, listas para sublimación. • Una vista mock-up de la taza para aprobar el resultado. Acepto sugerencias de paleta dentro de la línea sobria descrita, pero manteniendo la cruz y la Biblia como elementos centrales. La fraseología no se debe modificar; corrige solo tildes o puntuación mínima si fuese necesario. Si puedes entregar el arte impecable y listo para producción, empecemos hoy mismo.

opportunities.title: Meta Ads y Catálogo Sincronizado
opportunities.description: Quiero dejar todo mi ecosistema de Meta funcionando sin fisuras. La prioridad inmediata es que las campañas de anuncios en Meta queden bien configuradas y empiecen a correr con un objetivo claro de aumentar visitas y reconocimiento de marca. Trabajo con Tiendanube y necesito que el catálogo de la tienda se mantenga perfectamente sincronizado con Facebook e Instagram para que los anuncios din ámicos siempre muestren inventario actualizado. Esto es lo que espero: • Vincular y depurar Business Manager, Business Suite y Commerce Manager, asegurando que la cuenta publicitaria, la página de Facebook y el perfil de Instagram estén conectados entre sí y con la tienda. • Enlazar el catálogo de Tiendanube y activar feeds automáticos para que cualquier cambio de precio, stock o descripción se refleje al instante. • Diseñar la estructura inicial de campañas (conciencia y tráfico) segmentadas para Facebook, Instagram y, cuando corresponda, remarketing web, empleando las mejores prácticas de Meta Ads. • Configurar píxel y Conversion API de forma correcta, verificando eventos clave para analizar rendimiento. • Entregarme un pequeño instructivo con los pasos principales, nomenclatura usada y cómo pausar o escalar anuncios según resultados. Busco a alguien que domine Meta Ads, se mueva con soltura en Business Suite y ya haya conectado catálogos de Tiendanube u otras plataformas. Si dominas este flujo y puedes mostrarme casos similares, estaré encantado de colaborar contigo.

opportunities.title: Build a 3D co-op escape game in Unreal Engine 5 for PC (Steam) and PS5 – top-quality graphics and sound
opportunities.description: We are Sewar Al Tamayoz Group (Saudi Arabia). We have a complete, fully documented design for a first-person 3D escape game and want one studio or team to build it in Unreal Engine 5 for PC (Steam) and PlayStation 5, with cross-play. What you will build - 2 buildings, 13 rooms, 39 escape routes (3 per room); solo, online co-op for 2–4 players, and 2-player split screen - 4 stylized cartoon heroes with abilities; guards, searchlights, beasts and shades - A night system: progress carries over, and every random draw re-rolls from a seed - Player accounts, cross-play sessions and a leaderboard (weekly, all-time, daily), verified on the server by replaying each run - Full voice-over in English and Arabic (White Arabic), with a right-to-left Arabic UI - A closed beta with 15–20 teams, the Steam release and PS5 certification The quality we need - Graphics: stylized 3D animation at feature-film quality, matching the key art and 13 room mood images we supply. We provide all concept art; you make all production art from it. - Sound: an original score, and professional native-speaking voice actors in both languages, recorded in a studio and delivered as 48 kHz / 24-bit masters. You must have - Shipped Unreal Engine games: tell us how many games you have developed, with links - A portfolio of stylized 3D work at this level - Online multiplayer experience, and PlayStation development access (PlayStation Partners) or a plan to get it How to bid - This project has an NDA. Sign it to read the attached Studio Brief and Request for Quotation; the full design package goes to shortlisted bidders. - Price every line of the price schedule; the lines must add up to your bid. - Milestone payments: 10% / 15% / 15% / 15% / 15% / 20%, plus a 10% retention paid 90 days after launch. - All IP, AI-generated material included, transfers to us under the IP Agreement. We score proposals on graphics (30%), games developed (20%), price (20%), technical approach (15%), schedule and team (10%) and Arabic capability (5%).

opportunities.title: n8n AI Content Workflow
opportunities.description: I want a single n8n workflow that ingests our website, marketing-campaign, and social-media performance data, funnels it through two AI agents (Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini), and gives me a ready-to-use social media content plan. Workflow outline • Data collection – pull daily metrics from Google Analytics 4, Meta/Instagram, X (Twitter), LinkedIn, plus our email platform’s campaign stats. • Data preparation – deduplicate, normalise dates and UTM tags, then store the clean set in Postgres (or another lightweight DB you suggest). • AI processing – – Claude analyses the fresh data, surfaces trends, audience interests, and high-engagement topics. – Gemini turns those insights into a weekly calendar: post titles, short copy, suggested visuals, and ideal publish times for each network. • Output – push the content plan to a shared Google Sheet and send a formatted PDF summary to Slack. Acceptance criteria 1. Workflow runs on a schedule and can also be triggered manually. 2. Source APIs, DB connection, and both AI calls are fully parameterised with environment variables. 3. Claude’s analysis and Gemini’s content plan are saved separately and timestamped. 4. Clear README showing how to import, configure, and extend the flow. Please keep the solution entirely inside n8n (no external glue scripts) and use only official or widely adopted community nodes. If anything is unclear, feel free to ask before you start; I’ll respond quickly so we can keep momentum.

opportunities.title: Accelerate Web Scraping Automation
opportunities.description: My current browser-based scraper does everything I need in terms of accuracy, yet it still feels sluggish. I want a specialist to dive into the code, spot the bottlenecks, and refactor or redesign whatever is necessary so the whole run completes significantly faster—from initial launch to the final data export. You’ll be working with an existing setup that controls a headless browser (Selenium and Python right now, though I’m open to Playwright, Puppeteer, or other frameworks if they prove faster). Caching static assets, smarter wait conditions, asynchronous calls, or even switching drivers are all on the table—whatever reduces overall execution time without sacrificing reliability. Deliverables • A refactored script or module ready to drop into my project • A short performance report comparing before-and-after runtimes and explaining the changes made • Clear instructions for any new dependencies or environment tweaks I’ll test the new version against my standard batch of target pages; a successful hand-off is one that completes the scrape at noticeably higher speed while still returning the exact same data set.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40667013, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Build Autonomous API-Driven CEO Agent
opportunities.description: I want to delegate routine orchestration work to an AI “CEO” agent that can create, supervise, and report on the activities of other specialized agents without my constant involvement. Initial integration focus • Connect directly to n8n so the agent can read, trigger, and update my existing automations and workflows through the n8n API. • Handle incoming requests, decide which workflow they belong to, and route them accordingly. Core capabilities 1. API mastery – the agent must be structured so additional connectors (Claude for agent creation, Odoo for business data, Meta messaging, etc.) can be plugged in later without re-architecting the whole system. 2. Rule-based decision engine – when a workflow stalls or errors, it should attempt a predefined fix automatically. Only if the fix fails should it raise an alert for human review. 3. Monitoring & reporting – provide a lightweight dashboard or log feed that shows every delegated task’s status, retry attempts, and final outcome. Key deliverables • Working CEO agent running against my n8n instance with documented setup steps. • Configuration file or interface for defining the automatic-fix rules. • Alert mechanism (email, Slack, or webhook—your suggestion welcome) that triggers only after a failed self-repair. • Clear, extensible codebase and instructions on how to add future connectors to Claude, Odoo, and Meta. Acceptance criteria - Agent successfully routes at least three distinct incoming request types to the correct n8n workflows. - Demonstrated automatic fix on a controlled failure, followed by an alert when the fix is ineffective. - Real-time status view or log proving continuous monitoring. I value readable, well-documented code and prefer open-source libraries where practical. Let me know your proposed tech stack and timeline so we can get this CEO agent up and running quickly.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40824760, publicado hace 11 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.

opportunities.title: 2D Exercise Technique Animation
opportunities.description: I need a clean, professional 2D animation that teaches fitness trainers and gym members exactly how to perform one specific exercise. The short clip should: • Show the correct body position and movement from multiple camera angles so form is unmistakable. • Overlay the main muscles being activated—simple color highlights or semi-transparent anatomy layers are fine, as long as they are clear. • Briefly contrast common mistakes (for example, rounding the back or locking the knees) with the proper technique so viewers instantly see the difference. I have reference photos and written cues ready; you supply the storyboard, character design, full 2D rigging, smooth motion animation and synced call-outs. Adobe After Effects, Toon Boom or a comparable rig-based workflow is preferred so I can request tweaks frame-accurately. Final deliverables: 1080p MP4, the editable project file with all rigged assets, and a separate PNG or JPEG set of stills for quick printouts. The piece must stay under two minutes, maintain a clean medical-style aesthetic, and be persuasive enough for classroom screens or social-media reposts. Let me know your usual turnaround for draft, revisions and final render so we can lock a realistic timeline.

opportunities.title: Beauty E-Commerce Store Build
opportunities.description: Quiero lanzar “El paraíso de Ana” como una tienda en línea especializada en productos de belleza y cuidado personal. El objetivo principal es que cualquier visitante pueda elegir artículos, añadirlos al carrito y completar el pago sin fricciones desde un ordenador o un móvil. Alcance práctico • Diseño y desarrollo de la tienda completa en español, con un look fresco que evoque la idea de paraíso. • Catálogo autogestionable: necesito poder crear, editar o desactivar productos y categorías sin tocar código. • Integración de pasarelas de pago seguras (PayPal, Stripe o una alternativa local que me sugieras) y comprobación de que todo el flujo de compra funcione de principio a fin. • Panel de pedidos para ver estados, generar guías y marcar envíos. • Configuración básica de SEO on-page, velocidad y versión responsive. Entrego textos, logos y fotografías; espero de tu parte la tienda lista para producción y una breve guía de uso para que mi equipo la administre. Más adelante me interesaría añadir cuentas de usuario o valoraciones, por lo que agradeceré que el código quede limpio y escalable. Indícame la tecnología que prefieras (Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento o headless con React, por ejemplo) y el tiempo estimado; elegiré la opción que ofrezca el mejor equilibrio entre rendimiento, facilidad de mantenimiento y coste.

opportunities.title: Ongoing 3d artist needed for long term
opportunities.description: I’m looking to build a reliable, long-term partnership with a skilled Blender artist who can take product references and turn them into clean, photorealistic models and still renders on a regular basis. The bulk of my workload is product models and renders, so you should already feel at home creating accurate geometry, realistic materials, and studio-quality lighting inside Blender (Cycles or Eevee, whichever suits the brief). A typical job flow would be: • I supply reference photos, sketches, or CAD files. • You model and texture the product, set up lighting, and produce high-resolution images. • We go through one or two quick rounds of tweaks. • Final assets are delivered. Quedo a la espera de su propuesta y de ejemplos de búsquedas similares cerradas con éxito.

opportunities.title: Diseño Redes Sociales Multiplataforma
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo creativo para refrescar la presencia de mi marca en Instagram, Facebook, TikTok y LinkedIn. Necesito piezas visuales coherentes entre sí que mantengan la identidad de marca y se adapten a los formatos de cada plataforma. Alcance del encargo • Publicaciones para el feed: diseños cuadrados y verticales listos para programar, con espacio para copy. • Anuncios promocionales: artes pensadas para campañas pagadas en las mismas redes, optimizadas para alto CTR y con llamados a la acción claros. Qué espero recibir – Propuestas de estilo basadas en mi guía de marca (colores, tipografías y tono). – Archivos finales en PNG/JPG y versiones editables (PSD o AI). – Mockups o vistas previas que muestren cómo se verán dentro de cada plataforma. – Una breve guía de uso para que mi equipo pueda reaprovechar los elementos. Valoraré experiencia previa diseñando para social ads, dominio de herramientas como Photoshop, Illustrator o Figma y conocimiento de las mejores prácticas de cada red social. Indica en tu propuesta plazos estimados y ejemplos de trabajos similares.

opportunities.title: Contenido Integral para Meta Ads VIDEO y CRATIVIDAD ESTATICA
opportunities.description: Desde la actualización de ANDROMEDA en Meta ads, constantemente las campañas nos reclaman cambiar anuncios y añadir nuevas creatividades, nuevos vídeos, etc... Necesito piezas creativas que impulsen la captación de leads en mis campañas de Facebook e Instagram. Busco a una persona o equipo que se ocupe de principio a fin de la creación de: • Imágenes atractivas (estáticas o en carrusel) optimizadas para los formatos de Meta. • Videos cortos – máx. 30 segundos – para los formatos de las campañas de captación de leads. El equipo se debe encargar de: -Una modelo que sea la imagen del vídeo. -Grabar el contenido que le indiquemos según nuestros guiones. -Enviarnos los videos editados listos para que lancemos las campañas publicitarias. Precio por pack de 5 videos y 10 videos. Precio por pack de 4 imágenes y 10 imágenes. Valoraré experiencia previa en campañas de generación de leads, conocimiento de las políticas de anuncios de Meta y capacidad para iterar rápidamente según métricas. Si tienes casos de éxito, compártelos.
